about: Random event deck for the Dungeon Master extension. Edit freely: add events, change weight (0 disables), cooldown (player turns before it can repeat), once (never repeats), requires (flags like night, day, has_gold, injured, has_mounts; prefix ! to negate). settings: road, town, wild, dungeon, sea, any. danger: 1-5.

events.title: Highway ambush
events.seed: Armed robbers block the way and demand a toll; one of them is clearly new to this and nervous.

events.title: Wolves at dusk
events.seed: A hungry pack circles the camp, testing for the weakest member.

events.title: Bar brawl spills over
events.seed: A fight breaks out nearby and someone shoves a party member into the middle of it.

events.title: Cornered beast
events.seed: A wounded animal guarding its den attacks anyone who comes too close.

events.title: Hired thugs
events.seed: Someone the party annoyed has paid a few heavies to "teach them a lesson".

events.title: Grave robbers
events.seed: Diggers at a cemetery panic at being seen and turn their shovels into weapons.

events.title: Ambush at the ford
events.seed: Attackers wait where the party must cross water, slow and exposed.

events.title: Mistaken identity
events.seed: Bounty hunters are certain one of the party is their target and won't listen.

events.title: Patrol gone bad
events.seed: A corrupt patrol decides the party looks like an easy shakedown.

events.title: Trap trigger
events.seed: A pressure plate wakes something mechanical that was built to guard this place.

events.title: Something in the walls
events.seed: Scratching inside the stonework becomes many small, sharp shapes pouring out.

events.title: Pirate boarding
events.seed: Grappling hooks bite the rail; raiders want the cargo and anyone worth ransoming.

events.title: Bridge troll toll
events.seed: A huge creature claims the bridge and wants payment, or a meal.

events.title: Rival adventurers
events.seed: Another party wants the same prize and has decided talking is over.

events.title: Cult ambush
events.seed: Robed figures who've been following the party finally make their move.

events.title: Feral pack in the alleys
events.seed: Starving strays, desperate and territorial, corner the party in a dead end.

events.title: Animated armor
events.seed: The decorative armor in the hall turns its helm toward the party.

events.title: Swarm
events.seed: Insects, bats or rats pour out in a cloud; it's more chaos than danger, unless someone panics.

events.title: Duel challenge
events.seed: A proud local challenges a party member to a formal duel over an insult, real or imagined.

events.title: Escaped prisoner
events.seed: A shackled fugitive fights to steal the party's supplies and run.

events.title: Caravan raid
events.seed: Riders hit a caravan just ahead; the party can intervene or hide.

events.title: Ghoul in the crypt
events.seed: Something that used to be a person is still hungry.

events.title: Sea serpent
events.seed: A massive shape rises beside the ship and coils toward the deck.

events.title: Kidnapping in progress
events.seed: Someone is being dragged into a cart; the kidnappers are armed and in a hurry.

events.title: Bandit camp stumble
events.seed: The party walks straight into the edge of an outlaw camp; sentries shout.

events.title: Constructs on patrol
events.seed: Old guardian constructs still follow their last orders: no one passes.

events.title: Mercenary double-cross
events.seed: A hired sword traveling with the party (or met recently) was paid more by the other side.

events.title: Spider nest
events.seed: Webs everywhere, and the eggs are hatching.

events.title: Sinkhole lair
events.seed: The ground collapses into the den of something that does not like guests.

events.title: Revenge of the beaten
events.seed: Someone the party defeated earlier comes back with friends and a grudge.

events.title: Panicked mob
events.seed: A rumor turns a crowd violent and the party is in its way.

events.title: Stampede
events.seed: Spooked herd animals thunder toward the party with no time to think.

events.title: Assassin in the crowd
events.seed: A blade flashes toward a party member in a busy street.

events.title: Hunting party
events.seed: Hunters mistake the party for quarry, or decide they make better quarry.

events.title: Shadow stalker
events.seed: Something that hunts in darkness has been pacing the party for hours.

events.title: Raiders at the farm
events.seed: A farmstead is under attack; smoke rises and someone screams for help.

events.title: Collapsing fight
events.seed: A fight breaks out on unstable ground that is falling apart under everyone.

events.title: Smugglers' dock
events.seed: The party sees a contraband handoff and the smugglers see them.

events.title: Zealots' purge
events.seed: Zealous enforcers are rounding up "undesirables" and one of the party fits the description.

events.title: Golem gatekeeper
events.seed: A guardian blocks the only way forward and asks a question before attacking.

events.title: Barfight champion
events.seed: A friendly arm-wrestling contest escalates into a full, mostly good-natured brawl.

events.title: Escaped beast
events.seed: A creature from a menagerie or arena has broken loose in the streets.

events.title: Night raid on camp
events.seed: Shadows move between the trees while the party sleeps.

events.title: Turf war crossfire
events.seed: Two gangs clash in the street and both assume the party is with the other side.

events.title: Too-good trader
events.seed: A smiling merchant offers exactly what the party needs at a price that's suspiciously low.

events.title: Lost child
events.seed: A scared kid has lost their parent and latches onto the friendliest-looking party member.

events.title: Wandering bard
events.seed: A traveling musician wants to hear the party's story; it'll end up in a song, accurate or not.

events.title: Old acquaintance
events.seed: Someone from a party member's past recognizes them and wants to catch up, or settle something.

events.title: Pilgrims
events.seed: A group of pilgrims asks to travel with the party for safety.

events.title: Fortune teller
events.seed: A fortune teller insists on reading for one party member and says something unsettlingly accurate.

events.title: Proposal of marriage
events.seed: A smitten local makes a grand, public, very awkward declaration to a party member.

events.title: Drunken noble
events.seed: A drunk aristocrat takes offense, then takes a liking, then wants to hire the party on a whim.

events.title: Recruiting sergeant
events.seed: A recruiter tries hard to sign up the strongest-looking party member for the army.

events.title: Tax collector
events.seed: An official demands a tax nobody's heard of, backed by two bored guards.

events.title: Rival flirts
events.seed: A charming stranger flirts openly with a party member, maybe to make someone else jealous.

events.title: Street preacher
events.seed: A preacher singles out the party as an example of sin, or of salvation.

events.title: Gossiping innkeeper
events.seed: The innkeeper shares rumors, one of which concerns the party's current goal.

events.title: Refugees
events.seed: A column of refugees fleeing something; they're hungry and they know what's coming.

events.title: Merchant's plea
events.seed: A merchant begs for escorts; their last guards quit, and they won't say why.

events.title: Lost traveler
events.seed: A traveler is hopelessly lost and offers a reward to be guided somewhere.

events.title: The informant
events.seed: Someone whispers that they have information, for a price, and they're being watched.

events.title: Festival invitation
events.seed: Locals invite the party to tonight's festival: food, music, games, and someone's eye on them.

events.title: Jealous spouse
events.seed: An angry spouse accuses a party member of something they absolutely did not do.

events.title: Card game
events.seed: A card game with high stakes and at least one cheater at the table.

events.title: Apprentice wants a mentor
events.seed: An eager youngster begs to become a party member's apprentice and won't take no.

events.title: Crying in the rain
events.seed: Someone sits alone in the rain clutching a letter; they could use a kind word.

events.title: The debt collector
events.seed: A collector arrives looking for someone who borrowed money and named a party member as reference.

events.title: Talent scout
events.seed: A performer spots raw talent in a party member and offers them a stage tonight.

events.title: Hermit's wisdom
events.seed: A hermit offers cryptic advice, tea and something that might be useful later.

events.title: Shipboard gossip
events.seed: The crew has theories about the captain, the cargo and why they're really sailing.

events.title: Local hero
events.seed: Townsfolk mistake the party for famous heroes and throw a celebration they can't easily escape.

events.title: Bureaucratic maze
events.seed: The party needs a permit, and getting it means navigating a ridiculous office.

events.title: Missing pet
events.seed: A distraught owner offers a reward for their missing pet, last seen somewhere strange.

events.title: Old soldier
events.seed: A veteran shares war stories that turn out to be relevant to where the party is heading.

events.title: Hostile local
events.seed: Someone here hates outsiders, and they're stirring up the neighbors.

events.title: The matchmaker
events.seed: A busybody decides two party members (or a member and a local) are meant to be together.

events.title: Envoy's request
events.seed: A noble's envoy delivers a formal invitation that isn't really optional.

events.title: Bragging contest
events.seed: Patrons start trading tall tales and dare the party to top them.

events.title: Healer needs hands
events.seed: An overwhelmed healer asks for help with the sick and injured.

events.title: Smitten guard
events.seed: A guard is clearly sweet on a party member and might bend rules for them.

events.title: Rumor of treasure
events.seed: A drunk swears there's treasure nearby and draws a map on a napkin.

events.title: Child prodigy
events.seed: A clever kid asks sharp, uncomfortable questions about what the party is really doing.

events.title: Family dinner
events.seed: A local family insists on feeding the party and gets curious about their lives.

events.title: Shady recruiter
events.seed: Someone offers well-paid work, no questions asked, for people "with flexible morals".

events.title: Missionary
events.seed: A missionary wants to share their faith and won't be deterred easily.

events.title: Lovers' quarrel
events.seed: A couple's very public fight drags the party in as judges.

events.title: Wanted poster
events.seed: One of the party's faces is on a wanted poster. It's a bad likeness, but people are looking.

events.title: The messenger
events.seed: A breathless messenger finds the party with a letter that changes their plans.

events.title: Superstitious villagers
events.seed: Villagers believe the party brought bad luck and want them gone by sundown.

events.title: Cook-off
events.seed: A cooking contest needs one more entrant and the prize is genuinely useful.

events.title: Retired adventurer
events.seed: A retired adventurer offers advice, an old map and a warning about a past mistake.

events.title: Language barrier
events.seed: Someone urgently needs to say something, but nobody shares a language.

events.title: Fan club
events.seed: Someone has heard of the party's exploits and is a little too enthusiastic.

events.title: Crowded inn
events.seed: The only room left must be shared, with the party or with a stranger.

events.title: Desperate parent
events.seed: A parent begs the party to find a child who went somewhere dangerous.

events.title: The impostor
events.seed: Someone is going around pretending to be one of the party, and running up debts.

events.title: Stranded performers
events.seed: A theater troupe's wagon broke down; they'll put on a show for help.

events.title: Ex-lover
events.seed: A party member's old flame shows up, and it's complicated.

events.title: Philosopher
events.seed: A wandering thinker challenges the party with a question about what they're fighting for.

events.title: Night watch
events.seed: A lonely night watchman wants company and knows the city's secrets.

events.title: Bored royal
events.seed: A minor royal in disguise wants to tag along for an adventure.

events.title: The bet
events.seed: Someone bets the party can't do something silly, and the stakes are oddly high.

events.title: Rival party's taunt
events.seed: A rival group mocks the party publicly, daring them to prove themselves.

events.title: Sick traveler
events.seed: A traveler collapses with a fever; helping risks catching it.

events.title: Smuggler's offer
events.seed: A smuggler offers cheap, fast passage, with a small favor on the side.

events.title: Forgiveness
events.seed: Someone the party wronged (or think they did) approaches, ready to talk.

events.title: Guild dues
events.seed: The local guild insists the party pay dues to work here.

events.title: Witness
events.seed: The party is the only witness to a crime, and the culprit saw them see it.

events.title: Elder's story
events.seed: An elder tells a legend around the fire that turns out to be literally true.

events.title: The lonely ghost
events.seed: A harmless spirit just wants someone to hear its story.

events.title: Shipwrecked sailor
events.seed: A half-drowned sailor washes up, raving about what sank their ship.

events.title: Spoiled heir
events.seed: A spoiled heir hires the party for something ridiculous, and pays very well.

events.title: Cultural misunderstanding
events.seed: A party member accidentally commits a serious local faux pas.

events.title: Unexpected ally
events.seed: Someone from the enemy's side quietly approaches with an offer.

events.title: Pickpocket caught
events.seed: The party catches a young pickpocket red-handed; they have a sad story.

events.title: Rumor mill
events.seed: Everyone in town has heard a wildly exaggerated version of what the party did.

events.title: Abandoned wagon
events.seed: An overturned wagon, its owner nowhere to be seen; some cargo remains.

events.title: Hidden cache
events.seed: A loose stone hides someone's emergency stash and a note.

events.title: Dead adventurer
events.seed: The remains of an unlucky adventurer, with gear and a journal of their last days.

events.title: Market bargain
events.seed: A stall owner who doesn't know what they have is selling something valuable for pennies.

events.title: Washed ashore
events.seed: A sealed chest bobs in on the tide.

events.title: Payment in kind
events.seed: Someone the party helped earlier sends a gift: useful, odd, or both.

events.title: Lucky find
events.seed: Something glints in the dirt: coins, a ring, or something stranger.

events.title: Treasure map fragment
events.seed: A torn piece of a map, one of several, with a symbol the party recognizes.

events.title: Old armory
events.seed: A forgotten armory, mostly rust, but one piece is very well preserved.

events.title: Bounty board
events.seed: The bounty board has a job that pays well and fits the party's skills.

events.title: Collector's offer
events.seed: A collector offers good money for something the party carries.

events.title: Gambling windfall
events.seed: A party member's bet pays off big, and the loser is a sore loser.

events.title: Herb patch
events.seed: A patch of rare medicinal herbs, if someone knows how to harvest them.

events.title: Shrine offering
events.seed: A roadside shrine holds offerings; taking them might be a mistake.

events.title: Sunken boat
events.seed: A small sunken boat in clear water, something still aboard.

events.title: Merchant's thanks
events.seed: A merchant rewards the party for earlier help with a discount, or a secret.

events.title: Abandoned camp
events.seed: Someone left in a hurry: food still warm, supplies scattered. Why did they run?

events.title: The heirloom
events.seed: An heirloom turns up that belongs to an important family, and they'll want it back.

events.title: Strange coin
events.seed: An old coin from a place that shouldn't exist.

events.title: Smuggler's stash
events.seed: A smuggling hidey-hole full of contraband; someone will come for it.

events.title: Bird's nest trinket
events.seed: A magpie's nest is full of shiny things, including one that hums faintly.

events.title: Tip-off
events.seed: A grateful local shares where to find something useful cheaply.

events.title: Locked strongbox
events.seed: A heavy locked strongbox with no key and a faint ticking inside.

events.title: Prize from a contest
events.seed: A local contest's prize is exactly what the party needs.

events.title: Forgotten library
events.seed: Dusty shelves with one book that answers a question the party has.

events.title: Supply drop
events.seed: A cache left by an ally (or someone pretending to be one) with supplies and a message.

events.title: Dragon's dropped scale
events.seed: A huge shed scale, valuable, and a sign of what lives nearby.

events.title: Inheritance
events.seed: A lawyer finds the party: someone left one of them something, with strings attached.

events.title: Overlooked reward
events.seed: Someone pays what they owe the party, with interest and an apology.

events.title: Pawn shop gem
events.seed: A pawn shop has an item tied to the party's current goal.

events.title: Time slip
events.seed: For a moment everything repeats: the same words, the same gestures. Then it doesn't.

events.title: Talking animal
events.seed: An animal speaks, briefly and rudely, then acts like nothing happened.

events.title: Strange lights
events.seed: Floating lights drift through the dark, leading somewhere.

events.title: Doppelganger glimpse
events.seed: A party member sees their own face in the crowd, smiling at them.

events.title: Silent village
events.seed: A village where everyone has vanished mid-task. Meals on tables, doors open.

events.title: Dream sharing
events.seed: Two party members wake up having had the same dream.

events.title: Singing stones
events.seed: Stones hum when touched, together forming a melody someone recognizes.

events.title: Ghost procession
events.seed: A silent procession of translucent figures crosses the road and ignores the living.

events.title: Mirror message
events.seed: A message appears in a fogged mirror, written from the other side.

events.title: Unseasonal snow
events.seed: Snow falls in summer, only here, only now, and it's warm to the touch.

events.title: Wishing well
events.seed: A well that grants small wishes with uncomfortable literal twists.

events.title: Lost hours
events.seed: The party loses track of an hour; nobody remembers what happened in it.

events.title: The watcher
events.seed: A figure on a hill watches the party for days, always at the same distance.

events.title: Reversed shadows
events.seed: Everyone's shadow points the wrong way in this room.

events.title: Animal gathering
events.seed: Animals of every kind gather in a clearing, silent, waiting for something.

events.title: Possessed object
events.seed: An ordinary object starts acting with a will of its own.

events.title: Stopped clocks
events.seed: Every clock in town stopped at the same minute last night.

events.title: Prophetic graffiti
events.seed: Fresh graffiti describes what the party will do tomorrow.

events.title: Ghost ship
events.seed: A ship with tattered sails and no crew drifts alongside in the fog.

events.title: Tiny folk
events.seed: Tiny mischievous creatures steal small items and leave stranger ones behind.

events.title: Echoing voice
events.seed: An echo answers questions it shouldn't know the answers to.

events.title: Gravity hiccup
events.seed: For a few seconds, down isn't down anymore.

events.title: Old letter
events.seed: A letter addressed to a party member arrives, dated decades ago.

events.title: Starfall
events.seed: A falling star lands nearby. It's still warm, and something is moving inside.

events.title: Living statue
events.seed: A statue's head turns slowly to follow the party.

events.title: Familiar stranger
events.seed: A stranger knows all the party's names and seems surprised they don't know theirs.

events.title: Blood moon
events.seed: The moon rises red and every animal goes quiet. Locals bar their doors.

events.title: Painting that changes
events.seed: A painting's scene changes each time someone looks away.

events.title: Floating island
events.seed: A chunk of land drifts overhead, trailing roots and waterfalls.

events.title: Cursed coin
events.seed: A coin keeps returning to a party member's pocket, no matter what they do.

events.title: The invitation
events.seed: A black-edged invitation to a masquerade, with the party's names already on it.

events.title: Whispering wind
events.seed: The wind carries whispers of a conversation happening miles away.

events.title: Mushroom ring
events.seed: A perfect ring of mushrooms; stepping inside goes somewhere else.

events.title: Frozen moment
events.seed: A bird hangs motionless in the air, mid-flight, and the party can walk around it.

events.title: Underwater bells
events.seed: Bells ring from beneath the waves where no town should be.

events.title: Map that redraws
events.seed: The party's map has changed overnight, showing a new path.

events.title: Memory thief
events.seed: People here keep forgetting important things, and the party starts to as well.

events.title: Haunted lullaby
events.seed: A lullaby drifts through empty halls, sung by no one.

events.title: Eclipse
events.seed: The sun darkens at midday and something stirs in the shadow.

events.title: Fortune cookie truth
events.seed: A trivial fortune turns out to be precisely, eerily true.

events.title: Sudden storm
events.seed: A violent storm rolls in fast; shelter is needed now.

events.title: Thick fog
events.seed: Fog so thick the party can barely see each other; sounds come from odd directions.

events.title: Heat wave
events.seed: Brutal heat drains everyone; water becomes a real concern.

events.title: Flash flood
events.seed: Water roars down a dry gully toward the party.

events.title: Blizzard
events.seed: Snow and wind turn the world white; stopping might mean freezing.

events.title: Rockslide
events.seed: Rocks tumble down the slope, blocking the path and threatening anyone below.

events.title: Earthquake
events.seed: The ground shakes; buildings creak and something long-buried cracks open.

events.title: Wildfire
events.seed: Smoke on the horizon, then flames racing through dry brush toward the party.

events.title: Rainbow omen
events.seed: A double rainbow over the road; locals swear it means luck, or a wedding.

events.title: Calm sea
events.seed: The wind dies completely; the ship drifts and tempers fray.

events.title: Hailstorm
events.seed: Hail the size of eggs pounds down; everyone scrambles for cover.

events.title: Mudslide road
events.seed: The road is a river of mud; wagons and travelers are stuck.

events.title: Lightning strike
events.seed: Lightning hits a tree right beside the party and sets it ablaze.

events.title: Frozen river
events.seed: The only way across is over thin ice.

events.title: Sandstorm
events.seed: A wall of sand blots out the sun.

events.title: Tidal surge
events.seed: The sea rises unnaturally fast, flooding the docks.

events.title: Beautiful night
events.seed: A perfectly clear, warm night under a sky full of stars: a moment for quiet talk.

events.title: Morning mist
events.seed: Silver mist lifts slowly to reveal a view of something new.

events.title: Spring bloom
events.seed: Wildflowers everywhere; the world feels hopeful for a moment.

events.title: Aurora
events.seed: Ribbons of colored light dance across the sky.

events.title: Starving thief
events.seed: A starving thief steals food from the party; catching them is easy, but then what?

events.title: Bribe offer
events.seed: Someone offers the party a generous bribe to look the other way, just this once.

events.title: Wounded enemy
events.seed: A wounded enemy begs for mercy and offers information in return.

events.title: Injustice in the square
events.seed: A public punishment for a minor crime is about to go too far.

events.title: Two calls for help
events.seed: Two people need help in different places at the same time; the party can't reach both.

events.title: Poacher's family
events.seed: A poacher is caught; they're feeding a family the law doesn't care about.

events.title: Loyalty test
events.seed: An ally asks a party member to keep a secret that could hurt someone else.

events.title: Monster's child
events.seed: The creature the party was sent to kill is protecting its young.

events.title: Cheating merchant
events.seed: A merchant shortchanges a poor customer right in front of the party.

events.title: Desperate deserter
events.seed: A deserter from an army begs not to be turned in; the reward is tempting.

events.title: False accusation
events.seed: An innocent person is about to hang, and the party knows who really did it.

events.title: Blackmail material
events.seed: The party finds evidence that could ruin a powerful person who is not entirely bad.

events.title: Plague quarantine
events.seed: A sealed-off village begs for supplies; guards say no one goes in or out.

events.title: Stolen goods
events.seed: The party realizes something they bought (or received) was stolen from someone who needs it.

events.title: Revenge request
events.seed: A grieving parent asks the party to kill the person who hurt their child.

events.title: Slaver caravan
events.seed: A caravan carrying captives passes by, heavily guarded.

events.title: The easy lie
events.seed: A small lie would make everything easier, and hurt someone who'd never know.

events.title: Divided village
events.seed: Two factions in a village each ask the party to side with them.

events.title: Sacrifice tradition
events.seed: A village tradition demands an offering, and this year it's someone young.

events.title: Abandoned infant
events.seed: A basket, a baby, and no one around. The nearest town is a day away.

events.title: Rigged trial
events.seed: A trial is clearly rigged; speaking up would make powerful enemies.

events.title: Overdue debt
events.seed: Someone who owes the party money is obviously broke and ashamed.

events.title: The cursed volunteer
events.seed: Someone offers to carry a curse so the party doesn't have to.

events.title: Mercy kill
events.seed: A dying stranger begs to be put out of their misery.

events.title: Truth or comfort
events.seed: Someone asks a party member a question where the truth will break their heart.

events.title: Shortcut through sacred land
events.seed: The fastest route goes through land locals consider sacred.

events.title: Defector's price
events.seed: An enemy wants to defect but demands protection for their whole family.

events.title: Hoarder in a famine
events.seed: A merchant hoards grain while people go hungry, all perfectly legal.

events.title: Old promise
events.seed: Someone calls in a promise a party member made long ago, at the worst possible time.

events.title: Ally's dark secret
events.seed: The party discovers an ally did something terrible in the past.

events.title: Broken wheel
events.seed: A wheel cracks or a strap snaps; repairs cost time.

events.title: Wrong turn
events.seed: The party realizes they've been going the wrong way for hours.

events.title: Toll gate
events.seed: A new toll gate stands across the road, manned by someone with a ledger and a bad attitude.

events.title: Washed-out bridge
events.seed: The bridge is gone; the river is high and fast.

events.title: Shortcut offer
events.seed: A local offers a shortcut, and it would save days. It's also through somewhere unpleasant.

events.title: Mount goes lame
events.seed: A mount or pack animal is injured and can't go on at full pace.

events.title: Supplies spoiled
events.seed: Food has spoiled or been ruined; rationing starts now.

events.title: Ferry crossing
events.seed: The ferry operator is drunk, asleep, or charging three times the posted price.

events.title: Caravan company
events.seed: A merchant caravan heading the same way invites the party to join.

events.title: Border checkpoint
events.seed: Soldiers check papers at a border; the party's papers aren't quite right.

events.title: Mountain pass
events.seed: The pass is narrow, icy and long; it's slow going and something echoes above.

events.title: Ruins on the horizon
events.seed: Ruins not on any map are visible off the road.

events.title: Roadside inn
events.seed: A cozy roadside inn appears just as night falls, maybe too conveniently.

events.title: Swamp crossing
events.seed: The way forward is through leech-filled, fog-bound swamp.

events.title: Signpost vandalized
events.seed: Someone has turned the signposts around.

events.title: Long quiet road
events.seed: Hours of quiet travel: a chance for the party to talk about something real.

events.title: Campfire stories
events.seed: Around the campfire, someone asks a party member about their past.

events.title: Stowaway
events.seed: A stowaway is discovered among the gear, and they have a reason.

events.title: Ship takes on water
events.seed: A leak below deck needs fixing before it gets worse.

events.title: Becalmed and bored
events.seed: Nothing to do aboard for days; crew boredom turns into games and bets.

events.title: Port of call
events.seed: An unplanned stop at a port with its own trouble.

events.title: Following tracks
events.seed: Fresh tracks cross the path: big, recent, heading where the party is going.

events.title: Fork in the road
events.seed: Two roads, one longer and safer, one shorter with bad rumors.

events.title: Hitchhiker
events.seed: A traveler asks for a ride and is good company, maybe too good.

events.title: Lost supplies
events.seed: A pack is missing: fallen, forgotten, or stolen during the night.

events.title: Scenic overlook
events.seed: A breathtaking view and a perfect place to stop for a quiet moment.

events.title: Detour
events.seed: The main road is closed by order of someone important; the detour adds a day.

events.title: River travel
events.seed: The party can travel by boat for a stretch, with a chatty boatman.

events.title: Caught in the open
events.seed: No cover for miles and something is circling high above.

events.title: Night march
events.seed: Traveling at night to make up time; every sound feels bigger.

events.title: Fellow travelers' feud
events.seed: Two groups traveling alongside the party are feuding loudly.

events.title: Strange tracks in the snow
events.seed: Footprints in fresh snow appear and disappear without explanation.

events.title: Abandoned watchtower
events.seed: An old watchtower offers shelter, and a view of what's following the party.

events.title: Crossroads shrine
events.seed: Travelers leave offerings at a crossroads shrine; legend says the god listens.

events.title: Exhaustion
events.seed: Everyone is bone-tired; tempers are short and mistakes are coming unless they rest.

events.title: Missing persons
events.seed: People have been disappearing from one street, always on the same night of the week.

events.title: Coded message
events.seed: A coded note is found on a body, in a book, or under a door.

events.title: Locked room
events.seed: Someone was found dead in a room locked from the inside.

events.title: Poisoned well
events.seed: Villagers are falling sick; the water seems fine, but something is wrong.

events.title: Stolen relic
events.seed: A temple's relic was stolen during services, with everyone watching.

events.title: Secret door
events.seed: A draft from behind a bookshelf hints at a hidden passage.

events.title: Forged letter
events.seed: A letter with an important seal is a forgery, and a good one.

events.title: The informant's body
events.seed: The person who was going to talk is found dead before they could.

events.title: Strange symbol
events.seed: The same symbol appears chalked on walls everywhere the party goes.

events.title: Haunted house
events.seed: A house nobody will enter; lights go on inside at night.

events.title: Missing shipment
events.seed: A shipment vanished between two checkpoints with no sign of theft.

events.title: The mute witness
events.seed: The only witness can't or won't speak, but can draw.

events.title: Disguised visitor
events.seed: A visitor in town is not who they claim; small details give them away.

events.title: Animal deaths
events.seed: Livestock are found dead without a mark on them.

events.title: Unmarked grave
events.seed: A fresh, unmarked grave where no one has died.

events.title: Rumors of a tunnel
events.seed: Kids talk about a tunnel under the old mill that adults pretend not to know about.

events.title: Two stories
events.seed: Two witnesses tell completely different stories, and both seem honest.

events.title: The deal overheard
events.seed: Through a thin wall, the party overhears a deal that involves them.

events.title: The missing page
events.seed: A crucial page has been cut from a ledger, a diary or a holy book.

events.title: Shadow organization
events.seed: The same small pin is worn by several powerful people in town.

events.title: Mysterious benefactor
events.seed: Someone anonymously pays the party's bills and leaves no name.

events.title: Burned archive
events.seed: A records office burned last night; one drawer was emptied before the fire.

events.title: Sleepwalker
events.seed: A local sleepwalks to the same spot every night and digs.

events.title: Changed testimony
events.seed: A witness suddenly changes their story, and they look terrified.

events.title: Counterfeit coins
events.seed: Fake coins are flooding the market; some are in the party's purse.

events.title: Trail of clues
events.seed: Small clues lead somewhere, almost as if someone wants the party to follow.

events.title: Watched room
events.seed: The party's room was searched while they were out; nothing taken, everything moved.

events.title: Familiar handwriting
events.seed: A note is in the handwriting of someone who should be dead, or far away.

events.title: The vanished guard
events.seed: A guard post is empty, the fire still burning and the meal half-eaten.

events.title: Secret meeting
events.seed: Hooded figures gather at midnight; the party can follow, listen, or crash it.
